lessons_used: Predictions remain unreliable: high positive forecasts frequently overpredicted impact, while zero or negative forecasts sometimes preceded strong wins.
Adding new screens at the finish stage (finish, new_screen) consistently hurt performance across both agreeing tests (-15.5% and -8.8%).
Adding new flows during adoption (adoption, new_flow) consistently hurt performance or showed no clear effect across all 3 tests (-13.2%, -0.9%, and -4.5%).
Finish copy updates (finish, copy) showed no clear effect across both agreeing tests (+0.9% and +1.9%).
Waiting screen info updates (home, wait_info) mostly showed no clear effect across 9 of 13 tests, despite 3 winning tests (+6.4%, +3.6%, and +2.7%).
Kinds of changes with only 1 test provide weak evidence and cannot be treated as established patterns until replicated.

candidates.title: Story Screen Spotlight Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the story screen using a spotlight layout to highlight the pet companion concept before path selection.
candidates.why: The choose_path stage has a high mean time (514s), suggesting users linger on early story content without clear visual focus.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Companion
story.body: Adopt or create a digital friend to keep you company right on your desktop desktop screen.

guard.reason: Redesigns the story screen while still fulfilling its job of introducing the pet companion concept.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path redesign shows consistent slight gains across 9 prior tests, though step drop-off is low.

candidates.title: Sign In Account Continuity Guidance Hint
candidates.change: Adds a hint on the sign-in screen explaining that signing in with your original account restores existing pets.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple reports of pets missing or reset after users sign in again (8 emails).

sign_in.hint: Use the same email you signed up with to restore your existing desktop pets and settings automatically.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Pick Friend Carousel View Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the pick_friend screen with a carousel layout showcasing starter pets one at a time.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 78.8% with an average time of 1017s; a carousel makes browsing options faster and cleaner.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Companion
pick_friend.body: Swipe through available pets and select your favorite companion.

guard.reason: Redesigns the pick_friend screen with a carousel layout while preserving its job of allowing pet selection.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high drop-off, but redesigns historically show slight negative impact across 11 tests.

candidates.title: Sign In Stage Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Rebuilds the sign-in screen using a stage layout to highlight authentication methods sequentially.
candidates.why: Sign-in drops 11.9% of users and has an average completion time of 567s, indicating visual friction.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save Your Pet
sign_in.body: Log in to sync your desktop pet across devices and preserve your progress.

guard.reason: Redesigns the sign-in screen using a stage layout while preserving sign-in functionality.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in redesigns consistently underperform (-1.3% across 5 tests) and require UI work.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Stage Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the waiting screen layout to a stage layout showing generation visual feedback.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a long mean time (2336s); clear stage visuals keep users reassured during setup.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet Desktop Companion
waiting.body: Your companion is getting ready. It will appear on your desktop shortly.

guard.reason: Redesigns the waiting screen with visual feedback while still showing that the pet is being prepared.

candidates.score_note: Home redesign had positive single test result (+3.2%), but un-replicated evidence remains weak.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Carousel Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Presents the adoption certificate in a carousel layout emphasizing pet details and confirmation.
candidates.why: Adoption is the biggest funnel drop step (78.8% conversion); presenting certificate confirmation clearly improves completion confidence.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Summary
adoption_certificate.body: Review your companion details before welcoming them home.

guard.reason: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen layout within onboarding while preserving adoption confirmation.

candidates.score_note: High impact target step, but adoption redesigns trend negative over 11 tests.

candidates.title: Upload Photos Photo Quality Advice Hint
candidates.change: Adds a hint on the photo upload screen advising on clear photo upload requirements for custom pet creation.
candidates.why: Users reported issues where custom pet generation failed or looked wrong in support tickets (3 emails).

upload_photos.hint: Upload bright, well-lit photos with clear focus for the best custom pet rendering results.

guard.reason: Adds helpful photo quality guidance on the upload photos screen.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from support mail and funnel, but adoption hints consistently hurt conversion.

candidates.title: Home Intro Desktop Controls Guide Hint
candidates.change: Displays a hint on home_intro explaining how to access desktop pet controls and system tray menu.
candidates.why: Support mail shows confusion after onboarding about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet (3 emails).

home_intro.hint: Right-click your pet on the desktop or click the system tray icon to open controls, hide, or interact.

guard.reason: Adds a helpful hint on home_intro regarding desktop controls.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has high drop-off and support evidence, but finish hints have negative historical lift.

candidates.title: Choose Path Companion Selection Hint
candidates.change: Adds a helpful hint on the path choice screen clarifying that custom and pre-made paths can both be customized later.
candidates.why: Mean time on choose_path is high (514s), showing decision paralysis when picking a path.

choose_path.hint: Select custom or pre-made — you can customize your pet's appearance and behavior anytime later.

guard.reason: Adds a hint clarifying path selection options without restricting user choice.

candidates.score_note: Low cost hint with positive single test result (+1.5%), but target step drop-off is minor.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Docking Stage Visual Hint
candidates.change: Adds a clear hint on the waiting screen explaining that the pet docks into the desktop system tray when ready.
candidates.why: Users report pets missing from desktop or not opening (3 support emails); clarifying docking behavior reduces confusion.

waiting.hint: Once ready, your pet will dock to your desktop taskbar and system tray for easy access.

guard.reason: Adds helpful docking information on the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from support mail and funnel with reliable +1.4% positive trend across 13 tests.

lessons_next: Predictions remain unreliable: high positive forecasts frequently overpredicted impact, while zero or negative forecasts sometimes preceded strong wins.
Adding new screens at the finish stage (finish, new_screen) consistently hurt performance across both tests (-15.3% and -8.8%).
Adding new flows during adoption (adoption, new_flow) consistently hurt performance across all 3 tests (-13.2%, -0.9%, and -4.4%).
Finish copy updates (finish, copy) showed no clear effect across both tests (+0.9% and +1.9%).
Sign-in redesigns (sign_in, redesign) mostly hurt performance, failing across 4 of 6 tests (-3.7%, -2.7%, -3.3%, and -2.8%).
Kinds of changes tested only once provide thin evidence and require replication before forming a rule.
